ig_caption:
Sat, Nov 21: 7,249 deer reported statewide (4,089 antlered, 3,160 antlerless). Season total: 197,708.

Saturday's 7,249 new reports were the first daily increase since the opener, up from 5,698 Friday. A statewide high near 67F may have helped. Mason stood out, with 64% of its 86 new reports antlerless.
